meta.title: About Diana Gonçalves | Classical Pilates Instructor
meta.description: Diana Gonçalves is a Romana's Pilates certified Classical Pilates Instructor helping people move better, build control, and maintain long-term body health — all levels, beginner to athlete.

heading: Diana Gonçalves
photoAlt: Diana Gonçalves seated beside the wunda chair
bio: I'm Diana Gonçalves, a Classical Pilates Instructor dedicated to helping people move better, build control, and maintain long-term body health.

I hold the Romana's Pilates International Certification, with 900 hours across the full apparatus, in a program built to preserve Joseph Pilates's original work as he designed it. I continue my education through mentored private sessions with senior teachers to keep deepening my own practice.

I teach Classical Pilates to improve posture, flexibility, core control, and body awareness. I work with individuals of all levels, from complete beginners to advanced practitioners and athletes, including those recovering from injuries. Every session is tailored to your goals, whether you're building a foundation, deepening your practice, or training for performance.

My approach is thoughtful and precise, focusing on intentional movement, alignment, and sustainable results. Every session is designed to empower you to feel strong, confident, and connected to your body.

community.heading: Join the community
community.body: A space for Pilates beginners, intermediate movers, advanced practitioners, and athletes. Ask questions, share progress, and get movement tips you can actually use.
